_about: Thomas Aquinas in public-domain English beyond the Summa (the Summa itself is on the Adler shelf and keyed Latin-to-English by pipeline/build_aquinas_st.py; see docs/AQUINAS.md). Clean from CCEL: Rickaby's annotated, abridged Contra Gentiles (Of God and His Creatures, 1905) and the Oxford Catena Aurea on Matthew and Mark (Newman ed., 1841-42). From Gutenberg: Hugh Pope's On Prayer and the Contemplative Life (1914). Raw Internet Archive OCR: the English Dominican Contra Gentiles (Burns Oates, 1923-28; Books I, II, III part I and III part II; Book IV, 1929, was not found on the Archive), the Catena Aurea on Luke and John (Oxford, 1843-45, two parts each), Rickaby's Aquinas Ethicus (1892, 2 vols.), Procter's The Religious State (1902) and An Apology for the Religious Orders (1902), and H. C. O'Neill's New Things and Old in Saint Thomas Aquinas (1909). Rights: every item printed 1928 or earlier, US public domain. Added 2026-10-17 by the Aquinas thread; Lane A confirmed it holds no Aquinas. No uids minted.
